claim: According to Unicef, roughly 3.2 million children in Yemen were out of school even before the war escalated last month.
label: TRUE
annotatorNote: [AI label: Claude, 2026-10-06 - not yet checked by the human annotator] UNICEF's 2026 Humanitarian Action for Children appeal for Yemen (issued before September's escalation; its figures run to December 2025): 'Around 3.2 million children are out of school.' UNICEF's release of 16 Sep 2026 repeats '3.2 million school-aged children are out of school'. The same appeal's highlights box says '4.5 million children remain out of school': UNICEF's own figures differ, and the claim matches the one in the body and in the September release.
